title.en: Composition of the Armed Forces General Staff
title.orig: Composition of the Armed Forces General Staff

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 1 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00376_1960_html.txt

text.en:
The Armed Forces General Staff shall be organized into five Divisions, each under the direction
of an Assistant Chief of Staff, as follows:
(a) J-1, Personnel and Administrative Division
(b) J-2, Intelligence Division
(c) J-3, Organization, Operations, and Training Division
(d) J-4, Logistics Division
(e) J-5, Plans Division
